name: infer fs.readFile callback params are contextually typed
source: import fs from "node:fs"; function main(): void { fs.writeFileSync("/tmp/thaw-infer-rf.txt", "hello"); fs.readFile("/nonexistent-thaw-file", (e, d) => { console.log("cb", e!.code, d); fs.readFile("/tmp/thaw-infer-rf.txt", (err, data) => { console.log(err, data.length > 0); fs.readFile("/tmp/thaw-infer-rf.txt", "utf8", (err2, text) => console.log(err2, text)); }); }); }
